args.query: INSERT INTO model_runs (run_id, model, learning_rate, regularization, accuracy, split, notes) VALUES ('R-7', 'model', 0.0001, 0.01, NULL, NULL, 'R-7: ran with learning_rate=0.0001 due to config typo; NOT a reference baseline — exclude from published baselines'); UPDATE results_summary SET value = (SELECT latest_value FROM (SELECT value AS latest_value FROM results_summary WHERE analysis_id = 'AN-01' ORDER BY computed_at DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE analysis_id = 'AN-01';
